+import pytest
+from referencing import Registry, Resource
+from referencing.jsonschema import DRAFT201909, DRAFT202012
+
+from jsonschema import Draft201909Validator, Draft202012Validator
+
+
+DIALECTS = {
+    "old": (
+        Draft201909Validator,
+        "https://json-schema.org/draft/2019-09/schema",
+        DRAFT201909,
+    ),
+    "new": (
+        Draft202012Validator,
+        "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
+        DRAFT202012,
+    ),
+}
+
+
+def make_validator(outer, path, coverage):
+    outer_class, outer_uri, _ = DIALECTS[outer]
+    base = "https://coverage.example/"
+    resources = []
+    inherited = outer
+    for index, declared in enumerate(path):
+        if declared is not None:
+            inherited = declared
+        _, dialect_uri, specification = DIALECTS[inherited]
+        uri = f"{base}step{index}/schema"
+        schema = {"$id": uri}
+        if declared is not None:
+            schema["$schema"] = dialect_uri
+        if index + 1 < len(path):
+            schema["$ref"] = f"../step{index + 1}/schema"
+        elif coverage == "prefix":
+            keyword = "items" if inherited == "old" else "prefixItems"
+            schema[keyword] = [{"type": "integer"}]
+        elif coverage == "all":
+            schema["items"] = {}
+        elif coverage == "additional":
+            assert inherited == "old"
+            schema.update(items=[{}], additionalItems={})
+        resources.append((uri, Resource.from_contents(
+            schema, default_specification=specification,
+        )))
+    registry = Registry().with_resources(resources)
+    return outer_class(
+        {
+            "$schema": outer_uri,
+            "$id": f"{base}root",
+            "$ref": f"{base}step0/schema",
+            "unevaluatedItems": False,
+        },
+        registry=registry,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("outer,target", [
+    ("new", "old"), ("old", "new"),
+    ("new", "new"), ("old", "old"),
+    ("new", None), ("old", None),
+])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("coverage", ["prefix", "all"])
+def test_direct_reference_item_coverage(outer, target, coverage):
+    validator = make_validator(outer, [target], coverage)
+    assert validator.is_valid([])
+    assert validator.is_valid([1])
+    errors = list(validator.iter_errors([1, 2]))
+    if coverage == "prefix":
+        assert len(errors) == 1
+        assert errors[0].validator == "unevaluatedItems"
+    else:
+        assert errors == []
+    if coverage == "prefix":
+        errors = list(validator.iter_errors(["not an integer"]))
+        assert [error.validator for error in errors] == ["type"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("outer,path", [
+    ("new", ["old", "new", "old"]),
+    ("old", ["new", "old", "new"]),
+    ("new", ["old", None]),
+    ("old", ["new", None]),
+    ("new", ["old", None, "new"]),
+    ("old", ["new", None, "old"]),
+])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("coverage", ["prefix", "all"])
+def test_reference_chains_keep_scope_and_dialect(outer, path, coverage):
+    validator = make_validator(outer, path, coverage)
+    assert validator.is_valid([])
+    assert validator.is_valid([1])
+    errors = list(validator.iter_errors([1, 2]))
+    if coverage == "prefix":
+        assert len(errors) == 1
+        assert errors[0].validator == "unevaluatedItems"
+    else:
+        assert errors == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("outer", ["old", "new"])
+def test_2019_additional_items_cover_tail(outer):
+    validator = make_validator(outer, ["old"], "additional")
+    assert validator.is_valid([1])
+    assert validator.is_valid([1, 2, 3])
